title: The edit window for a Part Library entry is titled Edit Library Part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location, so its Part Library entry can be opened.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The window the pencil opens is titled "Edit Library Part", not "Edit Catalog Part".

Step 4:

  • The window closes without changes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
